_note: Real headlines captured from public RSS feeds on 2026-11-26. Summaries are short paraphrases, not publisher text. Used to build offline RSS fixtures so the pipeline can be tested without network access.

inc42.title: WhatsApp Rolls Out Message Scheduling Up To 14 Days In Advance
inc42.summary: WhatsApp is launching a feature that lets users schedule texts, photos and videos for delivery from 10 minutes to 14 days ahead.

inc42.title: XEBO.ai Bags $10.5 Mn To Expand Its Customer Experience Platform
inc42.summary: Dubai-based XEBO.ai raised $10.5 Mn in a Series A led by Emirates Growth Fund to build its feedback and experience analytics products and expand into North America.

inc42.title: Uber Appoints Former Zomato Food Delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan As India President
inc42.summary: Uber named Rakesh Ranjan, CEO of Allen Online and former head of Zomato's food delivery business, as its India and South Asia president from January 2027.

inc42.title: Green Aero Raises $14 Mn To Build Jet Engines, Combat Drones
inc42.summary: Bengaluru deeptech startup Green Aero raised $14 Mn in a Series A led by Crane Ventures to scale jet engine development and autonomous drone programmes.

inc42.title: Flipkart CEO Ousted, PhonePe Revives IPO & More
inc42.summary: Daily brief: Flipkart group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy steps down amid a kickback probe, PhonePe revives its IPO, PayU India hits adjusted EBITDA profitability.

inc42.title: Vegapay Bags $10 Mn To Scale Credit Line On UPI Infrastructure
inc42.summary: Mumbai fintech Vegapay raised $10 Mn in a Series A co-led by Vertex Ventures and Prosus to expand its technology for banks offering credit on UPI.

inc42.title: IT Secy Defends Sarvam's Token Factory Over Chinese LLM Debate
inc42.summary: MeitY secretary S Krishnan said Sarvam hosting overseas AI models on its Token Factory does not breach IndiaAI Mission principles; a scheme to support AI inference is planned.

inc42.title: Kalyan Krishnamurthy's Exit: How Walmart's Kickback Probe, IPO Delay Shook Up Flipkart
inc42.summary: Walmart reportedly asked Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down amid a seller kickback investigation, IPO delays and rising losses; Balaji Thiagarajan named interim head.

inc42.title: Navi Crosses 5% UPI Market Share As PhonePe, Google Pay Slip In October
inc42.summary: NPCI data shows Navi's share of UPI transactions rose above 5% in October 2026 while PhonePe, Google Pay and Paytm each lost a little share.

inc42.title: Beyond Its Sovereignty Bet, What's Sarvam Really Mining?
inc42.summary: Analysis of Sarvam AI's full-stack enterprise AI strategy, its Token Factory, new model launches and early traction with voice agents in financial services.

yourstory.title: Karnataka names 47 startup winners under ELEVATE 2026
yourstory.summary: Karnataka selected 47 startups from the general ELEVATE 2026 call, part of 196 winners across four programme calls this year.

yourstory.title: Priyank Kharge targets Mangaluru with Rs 6,000 Cr regional growth push
yourstory.summary: Karnataka's IT minister urged companies to invest in Mangaluru under the Beyond Bengaluru strategy at the opening of Deloitte's new office there.

yourstory.title: Beyond UPI: Why many Indians still need help accessing basic banking services
yourstory.summary: Opinion: digital payment growth has not translated into wide use of basic banking, so assisted banking through local access points is still needed.

yourstory.title: Piramal Alternatives invests Rs 225 Cr in Ardee Engineering
yourstory.summary: Piramal Alternatives invested Rs 225 crore in Ardee Engineering, a maker of pre-engineered buildings, to fund capacity expansion.

yourstory.title: Amazon's cumulative ecommerce exports from India reach $27B
yourstory.summary: Amazon Global Selling has reached $27 billion in cumulative Indian ecommerce exports, with registered exporters up 20% in a year to 2.4 lakh.

yourstory.title: Goldman Sachs, Societe Generale buy Rs 920-Cr stake in Lenskart
yourstory.summary: Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale bought about 0.73% of Lenskart in NSE block deals worth roughly Rs 920 crore from Steadview Capital.

yourstory.title: India, Australia deepen education ties with focus on skills and edtech
yourstory.summary: An Australian delegation is in India to expand partnerships in skills training, vocational education and edtech, including at DIDAC India 2026 in Bengaluru.

yourstory.title: Karnataka clears Pixxel's Rs 350 Cr satellite manufacturing project
yourstory.summary: Karnataka approved Pixxel's Rs 350 crore satellite manufacturing facility about two weeks after the application was filed.

yourstory.title: PhonePe resumes IPO process; targets listing in Feb-March at $12-15B valuation
yourstory.summary: PhonePe has revived its IPO plans, targeting a February-March listing at a $12-15 billion valuation via an offer-for-sale, according to merchant bankers.

yourstory.title: VU Venture Partners launches India VC accelerator, investment platform
yourstory.summary: VU Venture Partners is bringing its VC accelerator to India with seed and Series A cheques of $100,000 to $1 million; first cohort starts April 2027.

techcrunch.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
techcrunch.summary: The FCC approved SpaceX's plan for orbital AI data centers, dismissing objections about impact on scientific research.

techcrunch.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
techcrunch.summary: OpenAI plans a single usage meter for ChatGPT as it combines Chat and Work, so heavy users may reach limits faster.

techcrunch.title: The canceled Tesla Cybertruck is the fastest-selling used truck in America
techcrunch.summary: Used Cybertrucks sold in 39 days on average last month versus 65 days for all used trucks.

techcrunch.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
techcrunch.summary: 1Password disclosed an attacker accessed an employee's corporate account and took some customer information; passwords were not compromised.

techcrunch.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
techcrunch.summary: New York banned AI chatbot toys for five years after research flagged safety problems for children.

techcrunch.title: Character.AI's plan to auction off users' private chats challenged by state AGs
techcrunch.summary: State attorneys general oppose Character.AI's bankruptcy sale, which would include chat data from over 21 million US accounts.

techcrunch.title: X's latest update for creators focuses on vertical video
techcrunch.summary: X released new creator tools centred on short-form vertical video to compete with YouTube and Instagram.

techcrunch.title: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages in group and individual chats
techcrunch.summary: WhatsApp users can now schedule messages in group and one-on-one chats, from 10 minutes to 14 days ahead.

techcrunch.title: Allstate suffers multi-day tech outage ahead of Thanksgiving
techcrunch.summary: Insurer Allstate had a multi-day technology outage just before the Thanksgiving travel period.

techcrunch.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers' details were stolen in data breach
techcrunch.summary: Todoist confirmed a hacker reached production systems and stole data on about 6% of customers, including emails and password hashes.

techcrunch.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
techcrunch.summary: Amazon and Meta are reportedly negotiating to end a two-month blockade on the Muse AI agent.

techcrunch.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down next week amid IPO uncertainty
techcrunch.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy steps down next week; product and technology chief Balaji Thiagarajan will lead with the board until a successor is named.

techcrunch.title: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
techcrunch.summary: Investigators are focused on what Nvidia knew about where its chips ended up via Megaspeed.

techcrunch.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
techcrunch.summary: Huang remains opposed to a formal succession plan at Nvidia, even after the company spent two weeks without its founder.
